explanation: Kourovka 21.149 (current wording, v50): are there order automorphisms of Dlab groups not induced by conjugation by elements of a (possibly bigger) Dlab group? The Lean reads "induced by conjugation" very broadly (any injective homomorphism into any of the six Dlab groups with any slope group), so the negative existential is a strong form. GYZ (arXiv:2609.18630) prove it for order-preserving embeddings and rank-one slope groups. The linked KitaKen1 Lean file (which I confirmed exists) proves exactly this statement with witness D_⟨2⟩(I). Kourovka v50 still lists 21.149 without an answer, but the "solved" tag is backed by a machine-checked proof of this formalization. The Dlab-group definitions (locally right H-linear order automorphisms, with the six end conditions) follow Dlab/GYZ. The statement is faithful.
